text:
leo: Heads up 1 I opened a migration guide PR for the audit log schema change (adding `event_type` and `actor_id` fields) + updated SDK export examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012

anya: Link?

leo: PR includes: migration notes, deprecation timeline for /v1/audit/export-old, python/node/go snippets that show new fields, and a sample transform for existing JSONL exports.

mark: I'll update the Node snippet. We should show how to map old `action` -> new `event_type` and keep backward compat example.

legal: Please add a short line about PII handling: "When mapping identifiers, avoid exposing full user emails; prefer pseudonyms or hashed identifiers." Also avoid promises about backups being purged immediately.

anya: Good catch. I'll add a pseudonymization example and a note: "deletes remove records from active storage; backup retention follows our backup policy."

mark: Pushed Node commit: ```js
const stream = client.audit.export({format: 'jsonl'})
for await (const raw of stream) {
  const obj = JSON.parse(raw)
  // migration shim
  obj.event_type = obj.event_type || obj.action
  obj.actor_id = mask(obj.actor_email)
  console.log(JSON.stringify(obj))
}
```

leo: Added python + go snippets and a jq one-liner for support teams to transform old exports. python example: ```python
for rec in client.audit.export(format='jsonl'):
    rec['event_type'] = rec.get('event_type') or rec.get('action')
    rec['actor_id'] = pseudonymize(rec.get('actor_email'))
    print(json.dumps(rec))
```

ci-bot: Linkcheck: PR #1012 flagged broken link /sdk/go -> should be /sdk/go/quickstart.

leo: Fixing link now. Also added a migration table showing field mapping and a deprecation date (90 days).

legal: LGTM after pseudonymization note. Add sentence: "For DSRs, contact support; exported data will include pseudonymized actor identifiers by default."

docs-bot: docs-bot: all checks green after fixes. PR merged by leo.

anya: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a short internal playbook for SRE/support on how to use the jq transform during the transition.
